description: Poly Haven's `hidden_alley` collection in full — 39 CC0 models that are, between them, a ready-made City Z street kit: modular apartment and factory facades, fire escapes, chainlink fencing, electricity poles, street lamps, hydrants, bins, barriers, aircon units, roller shutters and alley clutter. Each entry lists the .gltf plus every .bin and texture it includes, with md5.
